responsibility: Implements the C-SKY backend’s main C target-hook and helper body for RTL expansion and target configuration. This file owns the executable logic behind the port’s calling convention state, register-class tables, address legitimacy and address-cost decisions, condition-code register description, built-in type initialization such as __fp16, C++ mangling for target-specific types, libgcc optab/libfunc setup for integer and floating operations, and other per-target routines referenced from csky.h, csky-protos.h, and the .md files. In practice it is the central non-declarative backend source that consumes GCC RTL/tree target interfaces and produces C-SKY-specific lowering, diagnostics, scheduling/cost choices, and hook implementations used during code generation.
same_name_distinction: This is the executable implementation file for the C-SKY port: it defines target-hook bodies and helper routines such as address-cost evaluation, fixed condition-code register handling, builtin and mangling setup, argument initialization, and libfunc/optab wiring, then instantiates targetm. Unlike csky.h it does not just declare target macros and policies, unlike csky.md it does not encode RTL instruction patterns and asm templates, and unlike csky.opt it does not define command-line options.
